name: cinematic-skill
description: An agent skill for narrated cinematic films built entirely from code: one continuous camera over photos, documents, cards and maps, every stamp, highlight and number landing on the narrator's word. Documentaries, product launches, brand stories, explainers.

interface.shortDescription: Narrated cinematic films built from code, timed to the voice.
interface.longDescription: An agent skill for narrated cinematic films built entirely from code: one continuous camera over photos, documents, cards and maps, every stamp, highlight and number landing on the narrator's word. Documentaries, product launches, brand stories, explainers.
defaultPrompt: Make a 90 second cinematic documentary about the Wright brothers.
Turn this product launch into a 60 second narrated film.
Make an explainer video about how coffee gets from cherry to cup.
